description: Baseline: 593.01 kb entry JS, 193.10 kb gzip, 71ms Chrome mount

description: Lazy load html-to-image on demand for card exports (-11.08 kb entry JS)

asi.result: Saved 11.08 kB entry JS and 3.87 kB entry gzip. All tests and checks passed.

description: Lazy load OnboardingTour via React.lazy (-46.67 kb entry JS)

description: Narrow App store subscription and memoize Header to isolate render tree

asi.result: Avoided cascading root re-renders on every keystroke/drag, bundle slightly reduced to 535.25 kb, all tests pass.
asi.hypothesis: Narrow App store subscription from full card object to (s) => s.card.ratio and cardType, and wrap Header in React.memo to isolate top-level re-render cascade.

description: Trim unused font weights from Google Fonts link in index.html (entry JS unchanged)

asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric entry_js_kb unchanged at 535.25 kb (affected only HTML network fonts).
asi.next_action_hint: HTML font optimization does not reduce entry JS bytes; combine with build asset pipeline or focus on JS chunk optimization.

asi.next_action_hint: Target es2022 produced identical JS output size; keep default target or explore minifier flags.

description: Code-split QRCodeSVG in CardPreview (-15.62kb entry JS, -5.85kb gzip)

asi.result: Shaved 15.62 kB off entry JS (down to 513.96 kB) and 5.85 kB off entry gzip (down to 163.86 kB). Mount time reached 61 ms. All 328 tests passed.
asi.hypothesis: Code-split QRCodeSVG in CardPreview via React.lazy and Suspense, keeping qr-container synchronous so tests and layout remain intact while deferring qrcode.react until QR code is displayed.

description: Ref-based studio shortcuts handler (slight +0.20kb entry JS increase)

asi.next_action_hint: useRef closure boilerplate increased entry JS (+0.20 kb); existing useEffect dependency array is already small and fast.

description: Eliminate @base-ui/react/field with native inputs (-8.91kb entry JS, -3.29kb gzip)

asi.result: Saved 8.91 kB entry JS (down to 505.05 kB), 3.29 kB entry gzip (down to 160.57 kB), and 8.90 kB total JS. All 328 tests pass cleanly.

asi.result: Saved 0.54 kB entry JS (down to 504.51 kB) and 0.20 kB gzip (down to 160.37 kB). All 328 tests and glossary checks passed.
